---
title: "How much trimmed sink rate is given up with span held to 0.508 m?"
---

{{< include _model.qmd >}}

```{python}
ENTRY_CEILING = 90.0   # s for this render, granted by the user
SOLVE_BUDGET = 15.0     # s for any one solve
PROBE_POOL = 200.0        # s granted for the probe
PROBE_SPENT = 192.5      # s the probe actually used

stall_angle = 6.7
span_baseline = 0.76
span_fuselage = 0.508

sink_baseline, opt_plane_baseline = optimize_geometry_for_sink_rate(get_airplane, alpha_max=stall_angle, span_max=span_baseline)
sink_fuselage, opt_plane = optimize_geometry_for_sink_rate(get_airplane, alpha_max=stall_angle, span_max=span_fuselage)

sink_penalty = sink_fuselage - sink_baseline
penalty_percent = (sink_penalty / sink_baseline) * 100
v_trim = opt_plane.v_trim
```

::: {.hero}
[`{python} f"{sink_penalty:.2f} m/s"`]{.hero-value}
[trimmed sink rate given up]{.hero-label}
:::

**Answer.** Restricting wing span to the [`{python} f"{span_fuselage:.3f} m"`]{.key} fuselage length increases the minimum trimmed sink rate from [`{python} f"{sink_baseline:.2f} m/s"`]{.key} to [`{python} f"{sink_fuselage:.2f} m/s"`]{.key}, giving up [`{python} f"{sink_penalty:.2f} m/s"`]{.key} ([{python} f"+{penalty_percent:.0f}%"]{.key}) relative to the [stall-bounded planform optimum](2026-09-29-03-what-is-the-minimum-trimmed-sink-rate-when-bounded-below-the-section-s.qmd). Induced drag from the lower aspect ratio drives the required trim airspeed up to [`{python} f"{v_trim:.2f} m/s"`]{.key} (@fig-span-constrained-planform).

```{python}
#| label: fig-span-constrained-planform
#| fig-cap: "Three-view geometry of the planform optimum with wing span held to fuselage length."
opt_plane.draw_three_view(show=False)
```
